BiblicalUsage: Challash means frail, weak — and it appears once, in Joel's call to war: beat your plowshares into swords, and let the weak say, I am strong.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the weak saying I am strong is not boasting — it is the only honest thing left to say when God calls.
